title: Citation Integrity Verdict
description: DISCOVER-stage hard-gate artifact. Output of citation-integrity-auditor. Derived mechanically from citation_checker.py over claim_list + claim_evidence_map. BLOCKs when: (1) a claim has no valid locus, (2) a locus has supports_claim=false (the linker read reported_result and judged the locus contradicting), (3) a locus has supports_claim omitted (linker must decide — conservative BLOCK), or (4) a ref is unresolvable. There is NO automatic numeric comparison — contradiction detection is the linker's explicit supports_claim decision, enforced deterministically by the gate. verdict BLOCK halts the DISCOVER stage.

unresolvable_refs.description: refs that could not be resolved to a real source

no_locus_claims.description: claim_ids that have no mapping in the claim_evidence_map or have only empty loci

contradicted_claims.description: claim_ids where a locus contradicts the claim: a locus has supports_claim=false (the linker read reported_result and judged it contradicting) or supports_claim is omitted (linker failed to decide — conservative BLOCK)
